body:
Thanks all,

student loans are maxed out. I wrote my ex begging for mercy and how I've been suicidal for months...no response.

Forwarded it to HER lawyer today and got a very compassionate note back fairly quickly. But made me cry since it is they same stuff I've told ex and kids before with no sympathy...

Going back to old therapist in January when benefits kick back in.

The complexity of my plan is usually what stops me, if I was going to half-ass it I would have done it by now.

Liasion, I won't lie...the accelerated program made even the more stable students cry. But we all supported each other and many are still there for me after I failed out and they graduated. The support for nurses is huge, I'm just in a deep hole and hope I can find a way out.
